action.description: Read the active hotbar action and store custom data on it.

assets.description: Turn mod-relative paths into asset URLs and pick the active provider for a texture kind.

authorization.description: Test build, grab, and tool permissions at cells and look up authorization zone ids.

blueprints.description: Serialize blueprint layouts and translate structure labels through the prefabulator.

building.description: Help place structures: snap positions, test blockage, choose what to build, or cancel.

camera.description: Return the camera to the player, focus a world point, or release focus.

collector.description: Read collector values per cell and element, test collectability, and report pickups.

constants.description: Read-only engine constants, including per-cell physics modes.

cooldown.description: Named per-mod cooldown timers you can check and consume.

discoveries.description: Mark elements and terrains as discovered in the player's log.

effects.description: Spawn short-lived visuals at world positions: waves, lasers, lights, and particles.

elements.description: Register custom element types and read or change falling-sand cells.

energy.description: Register energy types and add, consume, or read power on the network at a cell.

entities.description: Spawn, query, and control discrete world entities by id and type.

events.description: Subscribe to and emit named lifecycle and gameplay events.

excavation.description: Register named excavation profiles that define how digging behaves.

factory.description: Read factory level and per-process production counts and rates.

fire.description: Test whether a cell can burn and ignite it when the simulation is idle.

game.description: Control the game session lifecycle from your mod.

gameConfig.description: Read-only access to the game's global configuration values.

grid.description: Iterate rectangular or circular cell regions with a callback per cell.

hooks.description: Observe or override behavior at named engine hook points.

i18n.description: Register locale strings, translate keys, switch language, and format numbers.

input.description: Register key bindings, read the mouse cell, and query or drive binding state.

items.description: Register custom items and create or query item instances.

lights.description: Transient VFX lights and long-lived managed lights at world positions.

maps.description: List available maps and start a custom or vanilla map.

mods.description: Query asset providers contributed by other loaded mods.

patterns.description: Define reusable excavation shapes and apply them at a cell.

pickups.description: Spawn, query, remove, and collect loose items lying in the world.

pipes.description: Query and toggle liquid and gas pipes and the vents they connect to.

player.description: Read and control player position, movement, collision, inventory, and building unlocks.

processing.description: Register recipes for built-in Grower, Shaker, and Kinetic Press structures.

progression.description: Mark tutorial and progression steps as complete.

projectiles.description: Register projectile definitions and spawn them at world positions.

random.description: Seeded random numbers for deterministic, reproducible values.

raycast.description: Cast a ray from a world position and return what it hits.

reactions.description: Register contact rules that transform two elements when they touch.

rendering.description: Cell draw positions, grid metrics, overlay size, and custom overlay drawing.

resources.description: Collect fluxite at cells and update energy resource values.

scene.description: Read which scene is currently active.

schedule.description: Defer a callback until the next simulation tick.

settings.description: Read mod config from manifest configSchema and react when values change.

shared.description: SharedArrayBuffer storage for data shared between main and worker threads.

signals.description: Register handlers for signal target types.

sound.description: Play, layer, and stop sounds with optional distance-based volume and pan.

sprites.description: Load mod sprites, look them up by id, and manage player mod sprites.

storage.description: Persistent per-mod key-value storage and a device-local store.

structureBehaviors.description: Register custom conveyor and launcher behavior for transport structures.

structures.description: Register buildings, recipes, and processors; place, remove, and query structures on the grid.

tech.description: Register tech-tree nodes and read or change their locked state.

terrains.description: Register terrain types and create, damage, or remove terrain at cells.

time.description: Read game time in milliseconds and the current simulation tick.

tools.description: Inspect and control the grabber tool: size, active state, and load status.

triggers.description: Run a callback on a fixed interval with a configurable repeat count.

ui.description: Toasts, dialogs, tooltips, overlays, React UI, and controller-focus navigation.

upgrades.description: Register upgrade categories and trees; read chosen and unlocked levels.

utils.description: Geometry helpers: distance, direction, angle, and point interpolation.

workers.description: Enable this mod's post-update worker hook.

world.description: Read the cell grid, excavate, reveal fog, and run idle-safe world mutations.
